location.site_detail: CoreWeave Las Vegas deployment colocated at Switch's Las Vegas Tier 5 / CORE Campus; exact CoreWeave suite/building not disclosed in official sources reviewed.

status_as_of_cutoff: partial live / operational colocation as of 2026-08-11. CoreWeave announced an opened Las Vegas data center at Switch in 2021 and later identified Switch as the data-center partner for GB200/GB300 AI infrastructure deployments. Clark County records confirm separate 2026 land-use approvals for data-center/public-utility structures in the same Enterprise/Decatur corridor, but those county records do not name CoreWeave or establish CoreWeave-owned campus capacity.
evidence_grade: B: CoreWeave/Switch primary sources verify an operational Las Vegas/Switch deployment; official county records verify local data-center approvals nearby. Capacity, exact suite/building, and any dedicated CoreWeave-owned campus expansion remain unverified.

actions.result_status: CoreWeave announced it had opened a Las Vegas data center by partnering with Switch's Tier 5 data center in Las Vegas for VFX, machine-learning, AI, batch-processing, and pixel-streaming workloads.
actions.evidence_note: Primary company source supports operational CoreWeave presence in Las Vegas, but does not disclose MW capacity or the exact building.

actions.result_status: CoreWeave published a live demonstration of NVIDIA GB200 NVL72 infrastructure and identified Switch as its trusted data-center partner for the deployment.
actions.evidence_note: Primary source confirms advanced AI infrastructure with Switch, but does not independently state Las Vegas on the article page.

actions.result_status: CoreWeave announced an industry-first NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 bring-up, citing joint collaboration with Dell Technologies, Switch, and Vertiv; Switch separately stated the deployment was running in Rob Roy's EVO AI Factories.
actions.evidence_note: Primary CoreWeave and Switch sources verify a current AI-factory deployment relationship. Location is inferred from Switch's Las Vegas AI-factory context and should not be converted into a specific CoreWeave MW/building claim.

actions.government_body: Clark County Board of County Commissioners / Zoning Commission
actions.result_status: County minutes show approval of UC-26-0105-I I5 MOUNTAIN, LLC for public utility structures, including a data center with electric substation and ancillary structures on 55.10 acres in Enterprise, generally south of Serene Avenue and east of Decatur Boulevard.
actions.evidence_note: Official local-government record supports nearby data-center/public-utility land-use approval; it does not name CoreWeave and is not treated as CoreWeave-owned capacity.

owner: CoreWeave deployment/customer; underlying Las Vegas facility/campus operated by Switch

contradictions.details: Third-party trackers list CoreWeave Las Vegas capacity figures, but no official CoreWeave, Switch, or Clark County source reviewed published a CoreWeave-specific MW capacity. capacity_mw remains null.

CoreWeave and Switch primary sources prove an operational colocation/AI-factory relationship, while Clark County records prove local data-center approvals in the Enterprise/Decatur corridor. The county approvals do not name CoreWeave, so they are not evidence of a CoreWeave-owned campus expansion.
